desc: The XL1500 features a handsome, checkered, hardwood stock. With its daunting 25 ft-lbs of muzzle energy, and shot velocities of up to 1500 fps, small game - it's game over. Benjamin Nitro Piston powered break barrels produce 70% less noise than spring powered airguns, and with a smooth cocking effort, less recoil and less noise, a successful day of hunting is within reach. One simple cocking motion and your follow-up shots are fast, quiet and easy. Each Benjamin Trail NP break barrel comes with a 3-9x40 mm CenterPoint precision scope, featuring an adjustable objective and range estimating reticle. Trail NP air rifles feature a bull barrel, picatinny mounting rail system, installed sling mounts and a ventilated rubber recoil pad.
